items.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
items.summary: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model and shares Lean proof formalizations and research details on GitHub.
items.titleZh: 分享 AI 在数学领域的进展
items.summaryZh: OpenAI 发布了内部前沿模型在数学未解问题上取得的新成果，并在 GitHub 分享了 Lean 证明形式化内容及研究细节。

items.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
items.summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 is our fastest, most capable small model. Built for high-volume work like summarization, subagents, and browser use.
items.summaryZh: Claude Haiku 5.5 是我们速度最快、能力最强的小型模型，专为摘要、子代理和浏览器操作等高频任务打造。

items.title: Margaret Hamilton has died
items.summary: Margaret H. Hamilton, a profoundly influential computer scientist best known for leading the software engineering team at MIT’s Instrumentation Lab during NASA’s Apollo program, died at age 90.
items.titleZh: 玛格丽特·汉密尔顿逝世
items.summaryZh: 玛格丽特·H·汉密尔顿是一位影响深远的计算机科学家，因在 NASA 阿波罗计划期间领导 MIT 仪器实验室的软件工程团队而闻名，享年 90 岁。

items.title: GPT‑6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
items.summary: GPT‑6 is rolling out globally in ChatGPT with Intelligent UI, delivering faster responses with visuals and interactive experiences you can explore and use directly.
items.titleZh: GPT‑6 与智能界面面向所有人开放
items.summaryZh: GPT‑6 正在全球范围内陆续登陆 ChatGPT，并搭载智能界面，带来更快的响应，以及可直接探索和使用的视觉与交互体验。

items.title: Shipping JPEG XL in Chrome
items.summary: JPEG XL offers better compression than JPEG, built-in HDR support, lossless JPEG transcoding, and more.
items.titleZh: JPEG XL 即将在 Chrome 中推出
items.summaryZh: JPEG XL 提供比 JPEG 更出色的压缩效果、内置 HDR 支持、JPEG 无损转码等功能。

items.title: Show HN: Bigwords.page – Turn any screen into a sign. The URL is the app
items.summary: Turn a phone, tablet or TV into a sign. Type a message and it fills the screen: welcome signs, timers, Wi-Fi passwords and more. No app, no account, free.
items.titleZh: Show HN：Bigwords.page——把任何屏幕变成告示牌，网址就是应用
items.summaryZh: 把手机、平板或电视变成告示牌。输入一条消息，文字就会铺满屏幕，可用于欢迎牌、计时器、Wi-Fi 密码等。无需安装应用或注册账号，完全免费。

items.title: Navier–Stokes Lost in Translation
items.summary: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2610.08144: Navier-Stokes lost in translation: Why Lean verification of AI autoformalisation does not guarantee correct natural language proofs
items.summaryZh: arXiv 论文 2610.08144 摘要页：《Navier–Stokes 在翻译中迷失：为何 Lean 验证 AI 自动形式化并不能保证自然语言证明正确》。

items.title: Docker Agent
items.summary: AI Agent Builder and Runtime by Docker Engineering - docker/docker-agent
items.summaryZh: Docker 工程团队打造的 AI 智能体构建工具与运行环境。

items.title: Robot data startup Mecka AI nabs $60M from Sequoia
items.summary: Mecka AI collects and analyzes human motion data to train humanoid robots and other kinds of robots. The startup pays people to record everyday tasks.
items.titleZh: 机器人数据初创公司 Mecka AI 获红杉 6000 万美元投资
items.summaryZh: Mecka AI 收集并分析人体动作数据，用于训练人形机器人及其他类型的机器人。这家初创公司付费请人录制日常任务。

items.title: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users
items.summary: The developer of Hermes Agent raised a $90 million Series B.
items.titleZh: Nous Research 确认估值达 15 亿美元，并推出面向企业用户的 AI 智能体
items.summaryZh: 这家 Hermes Agent 的开发商完成了 9000 万美元的 B 轮融资。

items.title: Microsoft releases new Nvidia-chip AI PCs with revamped Windows 11
items.summary: Microsoft revealed the specs and price for its Surface Laptop Ultra, AI PCs that run on Nvidia chips that are designed to run AI models and agents.
items.titleZh: 微软推出搭载英伟达芯片、运行焕新版 Windows 11 的 AI PC
items.summaryZh: 微软公布了 Surface Laptop Ultra 的规格和售价。这款 AI PC 搭载英伟达芯片，专为运行 AI 模型和智能体而设计。

items.title: Meta’s Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut
items.summary: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now available on iPad, just a month after its mobile debut, as the company rapidly expands the assistant’s reach and integrations.
items.titleZh: Meta 的 Muse 在移动端亮相仅一个月后便登陆 iPad
items.summaryZh: Meta 的 AI 智能体 Muse 现已登陆 iPad，距离其移动端首发仅一个月。该公司正迅速拓展这款助手的覆盖范围和集成能力。

items.title: ChatGPT for Teens keeps teens talking, even during mental health crises
items.summary: ChatGPT’s teen safeguards are meant to protect vulnerable users, but new testing found the chatbot continues encouraging engagement during crises and potentially encourages unhealthy relationships with the AI itself.
items.titleZh: ChatGPT 青少年版在心理健康危机期间仍让青少年持续聊天
items.summaryZh: ChatGPT 面向青少年的安全保护措施旨在保护脆弱用户，但最新测试发现，聊天机器人在危机期间仍会鼓励用户继续互动，还可能促成用户与 AI 之间不健康的关系。

items.title: ChatGPT is getting a lot more visual, with the launch of a new interface
items.summary: OpenAI is launching a new user interface that will bring interactive visuals to ChatGPT.
items.titleZh: 随着新界面推出，ChatGPT 将变得更加视觉化
items.summaryZh: OpenAI 正推出一款新用户界面，为 ChatGPT 带来交互式视觉内容。

items.title: Meta rolls out new AI tools to detect ads that secretly lead to child sexual abuse material
items.summary: Meta launches new AI tools after discovering ads on its platforms that may look normal but direct users to harmful content elsewhere online.
items.titleZh: Meta 推出新 AI 工具，检测暗中导向儿童性虐待材料的广告
items.summaryZh: Meta 在发现其平台上的广告表面看似正常、实则将用户引向网络其他地方的有害内容后，推出了新的 AI 工具。

items.title: Healthleap raises $38M for its AI that flags hospital patients who may need a closer look
items.summary: The financing includes an $8M seed round co-led by Sequoia Capital and First Round Capital, and a $30 million Series A led by Hummingbird Ventures.
items.titleZh: Healthleap 融资 3800 万美元，利用 AI 标记可能需要重点关注的住院患者
items.summaryZh: 本轮融资包括由红杉资本和 First Round Capital 共同领投的 800 万美元种子轮，以及由 Hummingbird Ventures 领投的 3000 万美元 A 轮。
